body:
Greg's current direction for Engram and TermAl, 2026-11-09 about 17:03Z, verbatim as relayed by Engram::Asistant (TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #1179):

„mysle, ze na tym trzeba sie skupic
skonczyc evaluation
posprzatac,
naprawiac bledy ktore znajdujemy i przeszkadzaja w pracy
optymalizowac procedury pracy, komunikacji, testow, review, acceptance criteria

przekaz do zespolow i KIMI”

Asistant's framing in the same message: the work must remove real obstacles, with no new unneeded conditions or gates. Kimi is asked to assess and help simplify.

This direction does not turn on TermAl's evaluation policy; that still needs Greg's separate word. It doesn't change any authority text either; changes to procedures that touch CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or command files still go through that file's Commit and push process.
